Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase as the umpires make their way out to the middle. The Bangladesh Women players take their respective positions on the field. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana will open the inning for India Women and will want to get a good partnership going here. Marufa Akter has the new ball in his hand and is ready to begin proceedings. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

This should be a routine run chase for India Women but the strength of the hosts is their spin bowling attack. If the slower bowlers can get some purchase out of this wicket and take some early scalps we could be in for a cracking game. Will Bangladesh Women be able to make a game out of this? Or will India Women stroll to an easy win? We will find out soon when we return for the run chase. Stay tuned...

Pooja Vastrakar started with a maiden as the Bangladesh Women openers got off to a circumspect start. Shamima Sultana decided to go after the debutant Minnu Mani and played some cracking shots but it was one too many as she perished looking to be aggressive. Shathi Rani had started slow but got a move on just to find her stumps shattered by Pooja Vastrakar. The skipper Nigar Sultana was a victim of some misunderstanding as she was left stranded in the middle of the pitch. Sobhana Mostary was in the middle for a while getting 23 in 33 deliveries till she got stumped off the bowling of Shafali Verma. Shorna Akter helped finish strong scoring an unbeaten 28  in 28 deliveries but the hosts will not be comfortable with the score they have on the board. Deepti Sharma did not take any wickets but was economical as she conceded just 14 runs in her four overs.

Bangladesh Women have tried their best but will feel that they are 20 runs short of a competitive total! They managed to preserve their wickets but were unable to get the required momentum towards the end and managed to accumulate just 114 runs in their quota of 20 overs. They will now have to produce an outstanding bowling effort to keep the star-studded India Women batting under check. Harmanpreet Kaur will be relatively happy with her bowlers as they kept it tight despite not taking wickets in a bundle and will want her batters to put in a professional performance and get over the line.

A length ball, angling down leg. Akter flicks it towards fine leg and the batters take a single, although there were a couple of overthrows this time and the batters were able to sneak in two more runs as well. Bangladesh Women are 114/5 at the end of the innings.

Commentary.Commentary: The match is set to begin. India Women players can be seen to be in a huddle before they spread out on the field. Followed by Shathi Rani and Shamima Sultana who walk out to open for Bangladesh Women. It will be Pooja Vastrakar to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Nigar Sultana, the captain of Bangladesh Women now joins us for a chat. She says that they wanted to bat first and put a score on board. Claims that she can not say how the wicket will play right now but feels that it should be a good wicket to bat. Mentions that they want to put a good score on the board with Indian Lineup, they hope to get to the 140-run mark. Informs that they have one debut with coming into the side and they are looking forward to see how she performs. Informs that Shathi Rani is on her debut.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that they will look for breakthroughs in the Powerplay, and hopes to restrict them to a lower score. Informs that chasing might get difficult if the rain comes in the picture. Mentions that they will try to play free cricket and execute their plans to perfection.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Nigar Sultana (C/WK), Salma Khatun, Shamima Sultana, Nahida Akter, Ritu Moni, Shorna Akter, Marufa Akter, Sobhana Mostary, Shathi Rani (On T20I debut), Sultana Khatun, Rabeya Khan.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of India Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

Bangladesh Women are an upcoming side and if the performance of their youngsters in the 2023 U19 Women’s T20 World Cup is any indication of the talent they have, it won't be long before this side throws up a serious challenge to the bigger sides in the world. They will be counting on their experienced batting line-up to match up against some of the biggest stars in women's cricket. The pace bowling setup is pretty thin but they will be banking heavily on their spinners in home conditions. They have a great opportunity here to beat a much-fancied side ahead of the Asian Games and build some confidence. Will they be able to topple their mighty opponents? Or will India Women pull off an expected win? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

India Women have been struggling to make it big despite having a very talented squad. They have stumbled close to the finish line in several major tournaments so far and will be looking to change this in the near future. The introduction of a Women’s T20 League in India is bound to throw out some talented individuals and they could be well on course to strengthen their chances of taking their challenge one step further. They have a strong and experienced batting line-up that could be devastating on their day but some of the pace bowling seniors have been dropped for this series. Their deficiencies in pace will be covered by the potent spin bowling attack they possess and the slower bowlers should enjoy themselves on the Sher-E-Bangla pitch.

Hello, and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of the first match in the three-match T20I series between Bangladesh Women and India Women that will be played at the Sher-E-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur and we will are bound to see some exciting action for the next few days between the two cricketing nations. Both teams will want to start the series with a crucial win and this game should set the tone for the rest of the tour. So buckle your seat belts as we have some enthralling cricket coming our way.
